test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

She was amazed by / the unique architecture of / the Sydney Opera House.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. No error .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically correct and there are no errors in any of the parts.
 
• It is a simple declarative sentence that correctly uses the past tense ("was amazed") and the definite article ("the") before a proper noun ("Sydney Opera House").
 
• The structure of the sentence follows standard English syntax and conveys the intended meaning clearly.

Correct sentence: *She was amazed by the unique architecture of the Sydney Opera House.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The definite article "the" is used before a noun when the noun is specific and both the speaker and listener know what is being referred to.
 
• "Unique" is correctly used as an adjective describing the noun "architecture."
